O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Full checkpoints carry a non-tensor config object: STIL train saves checkpoint['args'] = args and DCL test reads checkpoint['args'].transform/.model/.base_model; a blanket weights_only=True rejects these, so test-time model reconstruction from checkpoint breaks unless the config type is allowlisted or stored as plain data. Optimizer/LR-scheduler state in optimization.ckpt must still load.
